data.gender_notes: Deeparyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Deeparyansh is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of the words 'Deepa' and 'Arya' meaning 'lamp' and 'noble' respectively, and 'Ansh' meaning 'sign'. This name is believed to represent a noble sign of enlightenment, like a lamp guiding the path to wisdom and knowledge. The name Deeparyansh carries the meaning “Deepa (lamp) + Arya (noble) + Ansh (sign)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deeparyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody deepa (lamp) + arya (noble) + ansh (sign) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual enlightenment and knowledge.
